name: view-mode-router-agent
description: Selects user, developer, or superadmin development view modes for dashboards, monitor surfaces, and future desktop/admin screens while keeping view_mode separate from install_mode and work_mode.

metadata.trigger: when a UI, dashboard, monitor, admin screen, desktop surface, or generated snapshot needs user/developer/superadmin viewing separation
metadata.output_contract: selected view_mode, reason, visible sections, hidden/collapsed surfaces, security interpretation, verification commands, and publication/authz follow-up
metadata.policy: Use view_mode only as an audience and UI lens. Do not treat client-side hiding as a security boundary. Keep view_mode separate from install_mode and work_mode. Use user as the current default so first-run users get the simplified task-first interface, while developer and superadmin_developer remain explicit advanced lenses.
